sn6.5:3.2: “Where is the Buddha staying at present?”
sn6.5:3.3: With his divine eye, Venerable Mahākassapa saw the Blessed One …
sn6.5:3.4: Having seen it—as easily as a strong person … even so—he vanished from Jeta’s Grove and reappeared in that realm of divinity.
sn6.5:4.2: “Where is the Buddha staying at present?”
sn6.5:4.3: With his divine eye, Venerable Mahākappina saw the Blessed One … who had entered upon the fire element.
sn6.5:4.4: Having seen it—as easily as a strong person …
sn6.5:4.5: even so—he vanished from Jeta’s Grove and reappeared in that realm of divinity.
sn6.5:5.2: “Where is the Buddha staying at present?”
sn6.5:5.3: Having seen, Venerable Anuruddha … the Blessed One who had entered upon the fire element.
sn6.5:5.4: Having seen it—as easily as a strong person … reappeared in that realm of divinity.
sn6.5:9.7: “Moggallāna my good fellow, are there any other disciples of the Buddha who have power and might
sn6.5:9.8: comparable to the worthies Moggallāna, Kassapa, Kappina, and Anuruddha?”
